Challenges

What is stopping your business from showing up in local search?

“Why can’t customers find us in ‘near me’ searches?”

Near-me rankings run on proximity, relevance and prominence. We audit which of the three is holding you back and fix that first.

“Why do competitors sit above us in the map pack?”

Usually a more complete profile, stronger review signals and cleaner citations. We benchmark the pack leaders and close each gap in order.

“Our profile gets views, but not calls or visits.”

Views without actions mean the profile informs but doesn’t persuade. Photos, services, attributes and review responses turn lookers into callers.

“Why won’t our city and service-area pages rank?”

Thin, duplicated location pages are the usual cause. We rebuild them with genuine local proof — areas served, local work, local reviews.

“How do reviews actually help rankings and trust?”

Review volume, rating and recency are ranking inputs and the first trust check buyers make. We build a steady, honest review flow into your process.

“Why don’t we appear in AI Overviews or AI recommendations?”

AI tools cite businesses with consistent, structured local data. We align your profile, citations and schema so the tools can confidently name you.

“Why don’t AI tools understand our services and locations?”

Conflicting names, addresses and service lists across the web confuse them. One canonical record, repeated everywhere, fixes it.

“How do I know if my site is optimised for local and mobile search?”

Our local audit checks exactly that — profile health, citations, location pages, mobile speed and call tracking — and reports it in plain language.

SEO Growth

How local SEO turns searches into customer activity

Local search is intent at its purest: someone nearby, ready to buy. Winning it takes a fully optimised Google Business Profile, consistent citations, a review engine and location pages that prove relevance for every area you serve.

We build all four as one system, tracked location-by-location in SERPLoft™, so you can see exactly which neighbourhoods you are winning and which are next.

Getting found

It starts with being present where local demand happens: the map pack, local organic results and AI recommendations. Complete profiles, consistent citations and location pages built on real local proof put you in all three.

Getting chosen

Visibility alone doesn’t ring the phone. Ratings, review recency, photos and clear service lists are what make a searcher pick you over the two businesses beside you — so we optimise the choice, not just the ranking.

Getting contacted

Calls, direction requests and bookings are tracked as the scoreboard. If visibility rises but the phone doesn’t, we fix the path from listing to contact until it does.

Where AI fits in

AI assistants now answer “best near me” questions directly. They recommend businesses whose local data is consistent and well-reviewed — the same foundations this program builds, which is why local SEO and AI visibility are now the same work.

Tracking what matters

Rankings by neighbourhood, calls recorded, reviews counted. You see the activity local SEO is supposed to produce — customers, not just positions.

FAQs

FAQs on local SEO

How long until we appear in the map pack?

Profile and citation fixes can move visibility in weeks; competitive categories typically need 3–6 months of reviews and authority work.

Do reviews really affect rankings?

Yes — rating, volume and recency are among the strongest local ranking factors, and they drive clicks even when rank is equal.

We serve several cities. Can one website rank in all of them?

Yes, with properly built location pages and a profile strategy per area — that is exactly what this service sets up.

Do you manage our profiles ongoing?

Yes — posts, photos, Q&A, review responses and accuracy checks are part of the monthly program.
